opening.argument: The presentation solicits at least $100 in Bitcoin for a managed trading pool, promising that the Bitcoin will be traded for participants and describing daily growth through compounding. It presents trading as requiring no knowledge while framing back-office screens and seven-day bonus timing as operational program benefits. It also offers a 10% referral reward and a weekly binary bonus conditioned on personally introducing one person on each side and maintaining at least $200 in one's own position. These features establish a recruitment-linked investment program, although the available video evidence does not establish that deposits, trades, withdrawals, or returns occurred.

citations.quote: You join the trading pool with a minimum of a hundred dollars of Bitcoin. Your Bitcoin is traded for you from Monday to Friday.
the idea of mirror trading international is to grow your bitcoin daily so be sure to look at the bitcoin as it will be compounding daily
you will get a 10% direct referral bonus.
You will also need to have at least $200 in your own position. This will qualify you for the binary bonus and you will receive a weekly binary bonus for your smallest leg.
